summary: Check-Cap Ltd., a foreign private issuer trading on Nasdaq under MBAI, filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, updating the expected closing timeline for its business combination with MBody AI Corp. The merger is now projected to close in Q3 2026, within eight weeks, refining the prior second-half 2026 guidance. The Form F-1 registration statement was publicly filed on July 24, 2026, and the company has responded to all SEC staff comments. Shareholder approvals from both companies have been obtained. Closing remains subject to Form F-1 effectiveness, Nasdaq listing approval, and customary conditions. The transaction is a reverse merger where Check-Cap is the surviving listed entity acquiring MBody AI. Watch for regulatory approvals and Nasdaq final listing approval as key milestones.
